bio.text: Ryan Mackenzie is in his first term representing Pennsylvania's 7th Congressional District in the U.S. House, and chairs the Workforce Protections Subcommittee.
He served in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from 2012 to 2024 and earlier was policy director at the state Department of Labor and Industry.
Mackenzie graduated from Parkland High School, earned an undergraduate degree from New York University and an MBA from Harvard Business School, and lives in the Lehigh Valley.
